Name: Moody Farmer - Immersive Daily Mood System
Author: AnnaCharles
Description:
[center][b][size=6]Moody Farmer[/size][/b][/center]
[center][i]Give your farmer a little personality — because not every day is a good day.[/i][/center]

[center]Ever wake up in Stardew Valley and think, [i]“I wonder what kind of mood my farmer is in today?”[/i][/center]

[center][b]Moody Farmer[/b] adds a daily mood system that gives your farmer a random mood each morning.[/center]
[center]Some days you’ll feel fantastic, some days you’ll want to stay in bed, and some days… you’d really rather not talk to anyone.[/center]
[center]Each mood comes with its own gameplay effect, and some negative moods can be overcome simply by changing how you spend your day.[/center]

[center]With [b]Version 4.0.0[/b], Moody Farmer introduces the [b]Positive Moods Expansion[/b], adding four new positive moods and a recovery rhythm where a bad day is followed by something better.[/center]

[center][color=#f1c232][size=1][font=Verdana][b]A little support goes a long way.[/b][/font][/size][/color][/center]
[center][color=#f1c232][size=1][font=Verdana][b] Endorsements, comments, and feedback help these mods grow and inspire what comes next.[/b][/font][/size][/color][/center]
[center][color=#f1c232][size=1][font=Verdana][b] Thanks for being part of it.[/b][/font][/size][/color][/center]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52335/52335-1793849159-380647064.png[/img]

🌱 [b]THE MOODS[/b]
There are currently [b]12 possible moods[/b]:
😊 [b]Happy[/b] — You’re having a great day!
😐 [b]Neutral[/b] — Just another normal Stardew day.
😢 [b]Sad[/b] — Today isn’t feeling great. Spend some time talking to people around the valley to shake it off.
😴 [b]Bored[/b] — Everything feels a little too familiar. Visit different areas around the valley to get out of the rut.
🛌 [b]Lazy[/b] — Maybe today is a good day to take it easy. You simply don’t feel like doing much today.
🙃 [b]Antisocial[/b] — People? No thanks. Talking to villagers costs stamina.
💜 [b]Depression[/b] — When Sad isn’t dealt with, things can get worse.
😰 [b]Stressed[/b] — Some days, everything just feels like a bit too much.
[b]New positive moods in Version 4.0.0[/b]
🤩 [b]Excited[/b] — Full of adrenaline and ready to move.
🔥 [b]Motivated[/b] — You’ve got the energy to get things done.
😏 [b]Confident[/b] — You’re feeling capable and ready for a fight.
🥰 [b]Affectionate[/b] — You’re feeling especially warm toward the people around you.
🎨 [b]CUTE MOOD ICONS[/b]
Your current mood is displayed as a small cute icon above the stamina bar, so you can quickly see how your farmer is feeling without opening a menu.
Each mood has its own icon.


🔄 [b]BAD DAY → GOOD DAY[/b]
Negative moods have one important rule:
[b]If you get a negative mood, the following day is guaranteed to be Happy.[/b]
This guarantee remains even if you manage to remove the negative mood early.


💜 [b]DEPRESSION[/b]
If you wake up [b]Sad[/b] and don’t overcome it during the day, the sadness can become [b]Depression[/b] the following morning.
Depression is a more serious mood that comes with stronger penalties and two ghosts that follow your farmer around.
The ghosts:
[list]
[*]Follow you indoors and outdoors[/*]
[*]Follow you between locations[/*]
[*]Cannot be killed[/*]
[*]Teleport away when hit and slowly return[/*]
[*]Deal damage when they catch you[/*]
[*]Disappear once Depression is cured[/*]
[/list]They’re there as a reminder that your farmer needs to take a break.


🚌 [b]TAKE A BREAK[/b]
The way to clear Depression is to [b]go home[/b].
While depressed, visit the [b]Bus Stop[/b] to choose whether to visit your hometown.
Taking the trip clears Depression, removes the anxiety ghosts, and gives your farmer a much-needed break.


🤯 [b]STRESSED[/b]
[b]Stressed[/b] is a deeper, more interactive mood than the original Moody Farmer moods.
Your farmer can simply wake up feeling stressed.
While Stressed, your farmer has a hidden [b]Relief[/b] level.
There’s no progress bar, no quest checklist, and no numbers constantly appearing on screen.
Instead, you naturally work through the mood by simply playing the game.
Things that can help relieve stress include:
[list]
[*]Talking to close friends[/*]
[*]Spending time with your spouse or partner[/*]
[*]Interacting with your pets[/*]
[*]Fishing[/*]
[*]Defeating monsters[/*]
[*]Relaxing at the Stardrop Saloon[/*]
[*]Spending some time at the Beach[/*]
[/list]As your farmer begins to feel better, the [b]Stressed mood icon changes colour[/b]:
[b]Red → Purple → Normal Skin Tone → Neutral[/b]
At high stress, tool actions that already use stamina cost a little more energy.
As the farmer relaxes, that extra cost gradually disappears.
Talking to people you aren’t close with while Stressed can also make your farmer a little short-tempered, causing a small friendship penalty.
But there’s no punishment for failing to completely overcome Stressed.
If the day ends while you’re still stressed, that’s okay.
[b]A stressful day is just a stressful day. Nothing more, nothing less.[/b]


❤️ [b]WHY MOODY FARMER?[/b]
Not every day is going to be a good day.
Sometimes you’re happy.
Sometimes you’re bored.
Sometimes you don’t feel like talking to anyone.
And sometimes… you just need to go home.
[b]Enjoy Moody Farmer![/b]



📦 [b]REQUIREMENTS[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b][/*]
[*][b]SMAPI 4.0+[/b][/*]
[*][b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] — Optional[/*]
[/list]

💡 [b]COMPATIBILITY / GAMEPLAY CLARIFICATION[/b]
Moody Farmer is built around [b]Stardew Valley and SMAPI’s normal runtime systems[/b] and does not depend on any other mod’s content.
Its mood mechanics use gameplay information already available through Stardew Valley, including NPC interactions, friendship, relationships, stamina use, fishing, combat, pets, and locations.
The mod does not generate, copy, rewrite, or redistribute NPC dialogue, portraits, sprites, schedules, character writing, or other NPC content.
It simply uses Stardew Valley’s existing gameplay information as part of its own predefined mood mechanics.
[b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] is supported.

🤖 [b]AI DISCLOSURE[/b]
The [b]AI-Generated Content[/b] tag reflects the use of AI assistance during development of Moody Farmer, including development of the mod’s code.
Some mood/UI icons were created with AI generation based on original concepts made specifically for Moody Farmer.
The mod itself was designed, tested, balanced, adjusted, and assembled by me.
[b]Moody Farmer does not use AI, an LLM, or any other generative system while Stardew Valley is running.[/b]
Daily moods are selected from a predefined set using the mod’s own programmed rules and randomisation. AI does not generate moods, NPC dialogue, character content, responses, or other gameplay content at runtime.
